entities.summary: Johnathan "John" Devante Jordan is an American naturalized Congolese basketball player who plays for FUS Rabat of the Division Excellence and the Basketball Africa League (BAL). He plays as point guard and played collegiately for Texas A&M University–Corpus Christi before turning professional in 2015.
